versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Costume Size Chef.
- Quickly assembles costumes from your existing clothes and household items, filtered by time and difficulty.
- Supports kid and adult sizing, solo, couple, and group costumes.
- Includes built-in safety checks for visibility, fabric, and prop rules.
- Generates a prioritized shopping list for any necessary low-cost purchases.
- Designed for last-minute needs: Halloween, school events, theme parties, and more.
